sentences.en: Subsequently,
sentences.zh: 由于警官没有在达莉亚身上发现任何伤痕，且一切看起来都很正常，他们便离开了。

sentences.en: Michael was free to go.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，达莉亚告诉迈克尔她怀上了他们的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Four days later, two officers from the Boynton Beach Police Department were dispatched to the Dippolito's home after receiving an anonymous call from a neighbour who
sentences.zh: 一个月后，即2009年5月1日，达莉亚告诉迈克尔，她接到了一个自称是博因顿海滩警察局赫尔利侦探的人打来的奇怪电话，

sentences.en: claimed the couple had been yelling all night.
sentences.zh: 对方告诉她，他知道她一直在做什么，并让她“向丈夫坦白”。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning, the neighbours stated they had seen Michael drag Dahlia inside by the hair.
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措的两人立即前往警察局找赫尔利侦探对质，结果被告知根本没有这个人。

sentences.en: They could still hear banging coming from the townhouse and feared for Dahlia's safety.

sentences.en: Officers arrived at the scene and separated the Dippolito's in order to question them individually.
sentences.zh: 几周后，迪波利托夫妇在洛杉矶健身房锻炼完回到车旁，发现挡风玻璃上有一张纸条，上面写着：

sentences.en: Both confirmed they had argued about money the previous night, but denied a physical altercation had taken place.
sentences.zh: 带上4万美元，上午9点30分回到这个车位，把钱放在你身后那辆车下面。

sentences.en: As the officers didn't notice any injuries on Dahlia and nothing seemed out of place, they left the property.
sentences.zh: 不要告诉任何人，尤其是你妻子。

sentences.en: It was later that night that Dahlia told Michael she was expecting their first child.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你所有已经发生、正在发生以及周五将要发生的事情。

sentences.en: One month later, on May 1 2009, Dahlia told Michael that she had received a strange phone call from someone named Detective Hurley of the Boynton Beach Police
sentences.zh: 不要告诉任何人。

sentences.en: Department who told her that he knew what she'd been doing and that she should, quote, confess to her husband.
sentences.zh: 独自前来。

sentences.en: Shaken, the couple immediately went to the police station to confront Detective Hurley, only to be told that no one by that name existed.
sentences.zh: 纸条的署名是“一个会帮你的人”，并附带了一个迈阿密区号的电话号码。

sentences.en: Although they were confused, they dismissed the call as a prank.
sentences.zh: 当达莉亚拨打这个号码时，一名女子接听并威胁要杀了她和她丈夫。

sentences.en: Several weeks later, the Dippolitos returned to Michael's car after a workout at LA Fitness and found a note on his windscreen that read,
sentences.zh: 迪波利托夫妇向警方报告了此事，并担心到考虑买一只护卫犬来保护自己。

sentences.en: Bring $40,000, 9.30am, back to this space and put it under the car behind you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔渴望彻底摆脱假释。

sentences.en: Do not tell anyone, especially your wife.
sentences.zh: 他聘请了一位律师，成功达成协议：如果他能支付剩余的191,000美元赔偿金，他的假释期将提前结束。

sentences.en: I will tell you all that has happened to you, is happening to you, and what will happen on Friday.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚主动提出出资91,000美元，迈克尔付给她剩余的100,000美元，以便她能一次性将全额转给他的律师。

sentences.en: Tell no one.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚给了迈克尔一张收据，确认转账已通过开曼群岛的一个账户完成，但收据也显示该交易已被撤销。

sentences.en: Come alone.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔让达莉亚去处理，一周后，她给了他一张全额191,000美元的银行本票。

sentences.en: The note was signed from someone who will help you and included a phone number with a Miami area code.
sentences.zh: 这张支票是从埃里克·陶的账户开出的，他是达莉亚朋友的丈夫。

sentences.en: When Dahlia called the number, a woman answered and threatened to kill both her and her husband.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚向迈克尔解释说，让埃里克开支票比等待开曼群岛的撤销交易到账要快。

sentences.en: The Dippolitos reported the incident to police and were so worried that they considered getting a guard dog for protection.
sentences.zh: 迪波利托夫妇带着支票去找迈克尔的律师，但就在他们准备递交时，达莉亚突然把支票抢了回去，说她想拿回她那91,000美元的贡献。

sentences.en: Michael was eager to be free of his probation once and for all.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，迈克尔驱车前往保险箱，取出了他最后的钱，总计140,000美元的现金和银行本票。

sentences.en: He hired a lawyer who successfully brokered an agreement that his probation would be terminated if he could pay the remaining $191,000 he owed in restitution.
sentences.zh: 他给了达莉亚91,000美元现金，换取了那张赔偿支票。

sentences.en: Dahlia offered to contribute $91,000 and Michael paid her the remaining $100,000 so that she could transfer the full amount to his lawyer in one transaction.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他把支票带到律师事务所时，发现金额被改成了只有191美元。

sentences.en: Dahlia provided Michael with a receipt confirming the transfer had been made via an account in the Cayman Islands, but the receipt also showed the transaction had been reversed.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔打电话给达莉亚，她解释说她和埃里克·陶吃午饭时，他一定是在吃饭时偷偷换了支票。

sentences.en: Michael asked Dahlia to sort it out and a week later, she gave him a cashier's cheque for the entire $191,000.
sentences.zh: 她退还了迈克尔给她的现金。

sentences.en: The cheque was written from the account of
sentences.zh: 埃里克同意再开一张191,000美元的赔偿总额支票，以换取迈克尔全部的140,000美元积蓄。

sentences.en: Eric Tao, who was Dahlia's friend's husband.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔随后将通过分期付款的方式偿还埃里克剩余的51,000美元外加利息。

sentences.en: Dahlia explained to Michael that it was quicker for Eric to write the cheque instead of waiting for the reversed transaction from the Cayman Islands to clear.
sentences.zh: 迪波利托夫妇带着埃里克的新支票回到迈克尔律师的办公室，却被告知另一位律师刚刚发来传真，

sentences.en: The Dippolitos took the cheque to Michael's lawyer, but as they were about to hand it over, Dahlia suddenly snatched it back, saying she wanted her $91,000 contribution returned.
sentences.zh: 称迈克尔的联排别墅上有留置权，在迈克尔还清债务之前，埃里克拥有该房产的合法占有权。

sentences.en: Desperate to have the issue resolved, Michael drove to his safety deposit box and withdrew the last of his money, which amounted to $140,000 in cash and cashier's cheques.
sentences.zh: 为了尽快解决这个问题，迈克尔开车去他的保险箱取出了他最后的积蓄，总计14万美元的现金和银行本票。

sentences.en: He gave Dahlia $91,000 cash in exchange for the restitution cheque.
sentences.zh: 他给了达莉亚9.1万美元现金，换取了那张赔偿支票。

sentences.en: However, when he took the cheque to his lawyer's office, they discovered it had been changed to just $191.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他把支票带到律师事务所时，他们发现支票金额被改成了仅191美元。

sentences.en: Michael called Dahlia, who explained she had met
sentences.zh: 迈克尔打电话给达莉亚，她解释说她曾与

sentences.en: Eric Tao for lunch and he must have somehow switched the cheques while they were eating.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·陶共进午餐，他一定是在吃饭时趁机调换了支票。

sentences.en: She returned the cash Michael had given her.
sentences.zh: 她退还了迈克尔给她的现金。

sentences.en: Eric agreed to cut another cheque for the total restitution amount of $191,000 in exchange for Michael's entire savings of $140,000.
sentences.zh: 埃里克同意再开一张总额为19.1万美元的赔偿支票，条件是迈克尔要交出他全部的14万美元积蓄。

sentences.en: Michael would then repay Eric the remaining $51,000 plus interest via a series of instalments.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔随后将通过分期付款的方式向埃里克偿还剩余的5.1万美元及利息。

sentences.en: The Dippolitos returned to Michael's lawyer's office with Eric's new cheque, only to be informed that another attorney had just sent a fax
sentences.zh: 迪波利托夫妇带着埃里克的新支票回到迈克尔的律师事务所，却被告知另一位律师刚刚发来传真，

sentences.en: advising there was a lien over Michael's townhouse that gave Eric rightful possession of the property until Michael had cleared his debt.
sentences.zh: 称迈克尔的联排别墅已被留置，在迈克尔还清债务之前，埃里克拥有该房产的合法占有权。

sentences.en: Frustrated by the ongoing complexities in what was supposed to be a simple and straightforward job, the lawyer fired Michael as a client.
sentences.zh: 由于本应简单直接的工作却不断出现复杂情况，律师解除了与迈克尔的代理关系。

sentences.en: Michael met with a new lawyer that same afternoon, but as the cheque was made out to the previous law firm, his new lawyer was unable to accept it.
sentences.zh: 当天下午，迈克尔见了一位新律师，但由于支票抬头写的是前一家律师事务所，新律师无法接受。

sentences.en: Eric said that he couldn't draw a new cheque as his accounts had been frozen due to his recent unusually high activity.
sentences.zh: 埃里克说他无法开具新支票，因为他最近账户活动异常频繁，已被冻结。

sentences.en: He promised to have a new cheque delivered as soon as his accounts were back in action, but Michael never heard from him again.
sentences.zh: 他承诺一旦账户恢复正常就会送来新支票，但迈克尔此后再也没有收到他的消息。

sentences.en: Eric later denied ever receiving any money from Michael, aside from $30,000 in cashier's cheques, which he claimed to have returned to Dahlia.
sentences.zh: 埃里克后来否认从迈克尔那里收到过任何钱，除了3万美元的银行本票，他声称已经退还给了达莉亚。

sentences.en: On April 2, Michael considered selling the townhouse to pay his restitution money,
sentences.zh: 4月2日，迈克尔考虑卖掉联排别墅来支付赔偿金，

sentences.en: but Dahlia was against the idea, telling Michael they had bigger things to worry about now that she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 但达莉亚反对这个想法，告诉迈克尔现在她怀孕了，他们有更重要的事情要担心。

sentences.en: Dahlia spent the next few months preparing for the baby by reading parenting books, debating possible names and attending regular doctor's appointments.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个月里，达莉亚通过阅读育儿书籍、讨论可能的婴儿名字以及定期参加产检，为迎接宝宝做准备。

sentences.en: To move past their money and trust issues, the Dippolitos also started seeing a marriage counsellor.
sentences.zh: 为了克服金钱和信任问题，迪波利托夫妇还开始寻求婚姻咨询。

sentences.en: On July 22, Dahlia told
sentences.zh: 7月22日，达莉亚告诉

sentences.en: Michael that a friend had recommended a lawyer who could help him get onto administrative probation while he was waiting to pay off his restitution.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，一位朋友向他推荐了一名律师，可以帮助他在等待支付赔偿金期间申请行政缓刑。

sentences.en: If successful, this meant he would no longer have to check in with his probation officer on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 如果成功，这意味着他以后就不必定期向缓刑监督官报到了。

sentences.en: Michael spoke with the lawyer, who suggested he sign his townhouse into someone else's name in case it had an effect on the administrative probation decision.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔与该律师进行了交谈，律师建议他将联排别墅过户到别人名下，以防影响行政缓刑的决定。

sentences.en: On July 31, Michael signed the property over to Dahlia.
sentences.zh: 7月31日，迈克尔将房产过户给了达莉亚。

sentences.en: The Dippolitos' conveyancing attorney advised that although Dahlia was now the sole owner, Florida's homestead laws meant
sentences.zh: 迪波利托夫妇的产权转让律师建议，尽管达莉亚现在是唯一业主，但根据佛罗里达州的宅地法，

sentences.en: Michael would still be required to sign off on any sale of the property.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔在出售该房产时仍需签字同意。

sentences.en: After being plagued by problems since the start of their marriage, it appeared as though the couple's issues might finally be over.
sentences.zh: 在婚后一直饱受问题困扰之后，这对夫妇的问题似乎终于要结束了。

sentences.en: Less than a week later, on the morning of August 5, 2009, Dahlia was informed of Michael's murder.
sentences.zh: 不到一周后，即2009年8月5日上午，达莉亚获悉迈克尔被谋杀的消息。

sentences.en: Looking visibly distraught, she was driven to the Boynton Beach Police Department to help with the investigation.
sentences.zh: 她神情沮丧，被带到博因顿海滩警察局协助调查。

sentences.en: Along the way, the detectives explained all they knew so far was that gunshots had been heard and a black man was witnessed running away from the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 在路上，警探们解释说，他们目前所知的一切就是有人听到了枪声，并目击到一名黑人男子从犯罪现场逃跑。

sentences.en: Dahlia said there had been a lot of black people visiting their predominantly white neighbourhood recently and recounted a couple of strange occurrences.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚说，他们这个以白人为主的社区最近有很多黑人出没，并讲述了几件奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: At the police station, head of the Major Cases Unit, Sergeant Paul Sheridan, took Dahlia into an interview room and asked if she knew anyone who would want to kill her husband.
sentences.zh: 在警察局，重案组组长保罗·谢里丹警官将达莉亚带进审讯室，询问她是否认识想要杀害她丈夫的人。

sentences.en: She explained that Michael was a recovering drug addict and alcoholic and an ex-con who still owed some people money.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，迈克尔曾是吸毒者和酒鬼，也是个前科犯，还欠着一些人的钱。

sentences.en: He was also due to testify at several upcoming fraud cases and owed his silent business partner at Mad Media $40,000.
sentences.zh: 他还要在即将到来的几起欺诈案件中出庭作证，并欠他Mad Media公司的隐名合伙人4万美元。

sentences.en: Michael had been bragging that his probation was ending soon and Dahlia said this might have upset some of his former telemarketing cohorts who weren't offered the
sentences.zh: 迈克尔一直在吹嘘他的缓刑期即将结束，达莉亚说这可能激怒了一些没有获得

sentences.en: same flexibility.
sentences.zh: 同样灵活待遇的前电话营销同事。

sentences.en: She claimed that one had approached Michael a few months earlier to make some kind of a demand, but she wasn't sure of the details.
sentences.zh: 她声称其中一人几个月前曾找过迈克尔提出某种要求，但她不确定具体细节。

sentences.en: Sergeant Sheridan informed Dahlia that Michael had let the killer into their house and was then shot twice in their bedroom.
sentences.zh: 谢里丹警官告诉达莉亚，迈克尔让凶手进了屋，然后在卧室里被连开两枪。

sentences.en: Dahlia was surprised, responding that
sentences.zh: 达莉亚很惊讶，回应说

sentences.zh: 迈克尔不会给不认识的人开门。

sentences.zh: 谢里丹警官随后离开房间，从现场警员那里获取更多信息。

sentences.en: He returned minutes later with a hand-cuffed black male, whom he said had been seen running from the DiPolito's property that morning.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，他带着一名戴手铐的黑人男子回来，说有人看到他那天早上从迪波利托家跑出来。

sentences.en: When asked if she recognised the man, Dahlia said she had never seen him before.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否认出这名男子时，达莉亚说她以前从未见过他。

sentences.zh: 随后，戴手铐的男子被带出了房间。

sentences.zh: 谢里丹警官沉默地盯着达莉亚看了几秒钟，然后通知她：

sentences.zh: 你今天因为教唆谋杀被捕了。

sentences.en: At the time of her marriage to Michael DiPolito in February of 2009, she and Mohamed had taken a break from their relationship.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月她与迈克尔·迪波利托结婚时，她和穆罕默德暂停了关系。

sentences.en: On March 17, two days after
sentences.zh: 3月17日，也就是

sentences.en: Michael's car was searched at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, Dahlia reached out to the now-separated
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的车在丽思卡尔顿酒店被搜查的两天后，达莉亚联系了当时已分居的

sentences.en: Mohamed and told him that her new husband was abusive.

sentences.zh: 穆罕默德给了她一位名叫罗伯特·威尔逊的警官的电话号码，达莉亚联系了他。

sentences.zh: 她解释说她丈夫有暴力倾向，她担心自己的生命安全。

sentences.en: As Dahlia was outside of Officer Wilson's jurisdiction, he told her she would have to report her concerns to the Boynton Beach Police Department if she wanted
sentences.zh: 由于达莉亚不在威尔逊警官的管辖范围内，他告诉她，如果她想

sentences.zh: 发起家庭暴力调查，就必须向博因顿海滩警察局报告她的担忧。

sentences.en: The following day, Dahlia and Mohamed met up for the first time since her marriage to Michael.
sentences.zh: 第二天，达莉亚和穆罕默德自她与迈克尔结婚以来第一次见面。

sentences.en: She surprised him with a gift of a $38,000 Range Rover, which she had paid for in cash.
sentences.zh: 她送给他一辆价值3.8万美元的路虎揽胜作为礼物，并用现金支付，给了他一个惊喜。

sentences.en: Dahlia registered the vehicle in Mohamed's name, confessing that she had used some of
sentences.zh: 达莉亚用穆罕默德的名字登记了这辆车，并承认她用了

sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，她询问穆罕默德是否能通过他在便利店经营的汇款服务帮她弄一张假的西联汇款单。

sentences.en: He refused, as he was audited monthly by the Inland Revenue Service.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了，因为他每月都要接受美国国税局的审计。

sentences.en: Instead, he helped Dahlia create an artificial receipt using a bank wire form that had been faxed from a bank in the Cayman Islands.
sentences.zh: 相反，他帮达莉亚利用一张从开曼群岛一家银行传真过来的银行电汇单制作了一张伪造收据。

sentences.zh: 3月下旬，

sentences.en: Dahlia and Mohamed met at Urban Wear, a clothing store in Riviera Beach owned by Mohamed's cousin.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚和穆罕默德在里维埃拉海滩的一家服装店Urban Wear见面，该店由穆罕默德的表弟拥有。

sentences.en: The store was frequented by members of the Buck Wild Gang, an organised crime group known to terrorise the area.
sentences.zh: 这家店经常有“Buck Wild”帮派的成员光顾，这是一个以恐吓该地区而闻名的有组织犯罪集团。

sentences.en: Dahlia loudly asked if Mohamed knew anyone who could kill her husband, and some of the gang members overheard and offered their services.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚大声询问穆罕默德是否认识能杀掉她丈夫的人，一些帮派成员听到了并主动提出提供服务。

sentences.en: Dahlia offered to pay a large sum of cash or hand over
sentences.zh: 达莉亚提出支付一大笔现金或交出

sentences.en: Mohamed's new Range Rover in return.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德的新路虎揽胜作为回报。

sentences.zh: 然后她坐上了一些帮派成员的车，开车经过她的联排别墅，向他们展示她住的地方。

sentences.en: Given there were a number of cameras, motion detectors, and alarms throughout the neighbourhood, the Buck Wild Gang deduced that it would be a difficult job to pull off.
sentences.zh: 鉴于社区内有大量的摄像头、运动探测器和警报器，“Buck Wild”帮派推断这是一项很难完成的任务。

sentences.en: A few days later, Mohamed received a phone call from one of the gang members who asked if
sentences.zh: 几天后，穆罕默德接到其中一名帮派成员的电话，询问

sentences.zh: 达莉亚是否是认真的。

sentences.zh: 穆罕默德警告他们不要接这个活，因为达莉亚已经在就她暴力丈夫的问题与一名警官交谈，因此风险太大。

sentences.en: The gang backed off and
sentences.zh: 帮派退缩了，

sentences.zh: 他用卖车的钱支付了离婚律师费，并带女儿去以色列度假。

sentences.en: When he returned on June 20 2009, he met up with Dahlia, who revealed that she had attempted

sentences.zh: 通过在迈克尔的车里放置毒品来让他违反缓刑规定，当时他们住在丽思卡尔顿酒店。

sentences.en: She had hidden the drugs in his gas cap and then called the police, but they didn't find them during their search.
sentences.zh: 她把毒品藏在他的油箱盖里，然后报了警，但他们在搜查时没有发现。

sentences.en: She also told Mohamed she was trying to figure out how to get the townhouse signed into her name.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉穆罕默德，她正在想办法把联排别墅过户到自己名下。

sentences.en: On July 31, the two met at a mobile gas station where Dahlia asked if Mohamed would kill her would kill her husband.
sentences.zh: 7月31日，两人在一家移动加油站见面，达莉亚问穆罕默德是否愿意杀掉她丈夫。

sentences.en: He flatly refused.
sentences.zh: 他断然拒绝了。

sentences.en: He then left her in the car alone for a minute and when he returned, he noticed the Glock semi-automatic firearm he kept in his glove box was missing.
sentences.zh: 随后他把她独自留在车里一分钟，回来时发现他放在手套箱里的格洛克半自动手枪不见了。

sentences.en: He asked Dahlia if she took it, but she denied doing so, before handing the gun over and saying she'd taken it as a joke.
sentences.zh: 他问达莉亚是不是她拿走了，但她否认了，随后又把枪交出来，说她只是开个玩笑。

sentences.en: It was at this point that Mohamed realised she was serious about wanting her husband dead.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，穆罕默德意识到她真的想让她丈夫死。

sentences.en: The following day, Mohamed agreed to see Dahlia again at the same mobile gas station.
sentences.zh: 第二天，穆罕默德同意在同一个移动加油站再次见达莉亚。

sentences.en: Sitting together in Mohamed's car, he asked why she wanted to go through with having
sentences.zh: 坐在穆罕默德的车里，他问她为什么要执意让

sentences.en: Michael murdered.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔被谋杀。

sentences.en: Dahlia responded that it had nothing to do with the money, but was about, quote, his fucking friends and all that other shit.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚回答说这与钱无关，而是关于，引用她的话，“他那些该死的朋友和所有其他破事”。

sentences.en: When Mohamed asked if anyone would suspect that Dahlia was behind the murder, she replied, why me?
sentences.zh: 当穆罕默德问是否有人会怀疑达莉亚是谋杀案的幕后黑手时，她回答说：“为什么是我？”

sentences.en: Like, do you know what fucking killing somebody is?
sentences.zh: “就像，你知道杀人是什么感觉吗？”

sentences.en: Nobody's going to be able to point a finger at me.
sentences.zh: “没人能指责我。”

sentences.en: Mohamed then offered to put Dahlia in touch with a former military hitman who was an illegal immigrant with nothing to lose.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德随后提出帮达莉亚联系一名一名前军事杀手，他是一名非法移民，没什么可失去的。

sentences.en: He explained that she would need to provide the hitman with a clear photo of Michael as well as $1,200 to buy a gun.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，她需要提供一张迈克尔的清晰照片以及1200美元买枪。

sentences.en: Dahlia agreed, saying she wanted the hit completed by Wednesday August 5.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚同意了，说她希望在8月5日星期三之前完成任务。

sentences.en: Mohamed reassured her it would be done by then, as the hitman was scheduled to fly to Costa Rica on Thursday August 6.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德向她保证到那时肯定会完成，因为杀手定于8月6日星期四飞往哥斯达黎加。

sentences.en: Dahlia counted out $1,200 from a wad of cash she had in her handbag and handed it to Mohamed.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚从手提包里的一叠现金中数出1200美元递给穆罕默德。

sentences.en: She also offered to give him $20,000 once the hit was done.
sentences.zh: 她还提出一旦任务完成就给他2万美元。

sentences.en: She took a bundle of photographs from her bag and handed over a photo of the townhouse and an individual shot of Michael.
sentences.zh: 她从包里拿出一叠照片，递给穆罕默德一张联排别墅的照片和一张迈克尔的单人照。

sentences.en: Dahlia then demanded, quote, wipe my fucking prints off those fucking pictures.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚随后要求道：“把那些该死的照片上我该死的指纹擦掉。”

sentences.en: When she asked if Mohamed was sure that everything was okay, he stated,
sentences.zh: 当她问穆罕默德是否确定一切都没问题时，他说：

sentences.en: no, I'm not sure because you're planning a murder.
sentences.zh: “不，我不确定，因为你在策划一起谋杀。”

sentences.en: In response, Dahlia told him to smile.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，达莉亚让他笑一笑。

sentences.en: What Dahlia didn't know was that after she had first asked Mohamed to kill Michael, he had gone to the Boynton
sentences.zh: 达莉亚不知道的是，在她第一次要求穆罕默德杀掉迈克尔后，他就去了博因顿

sentences.en: Beach Police Department to report that he was having an affair with a woman who was threatening to kill her husband.
sentences.zh: 海滩警察局报告说，他与一名威胁要杀害丈夫的女人有染。

sentences.en: As Mohamed was unsure of Dahlia's new married name, address or any details about Michael, the police doubted his story.
sentences.zh: 由于穆罕默德不确定达莉亚婚后的新姓氏、地址或关于迈克尔的任何细节，警方怀疑他的故事。

sentences.en: They only agreed to investigate on the condition that Mohamed act as a confidential informant.
sentences.zh: 他们只同意在穆罕默德担任秘密线人的条件下进行调查。

sentences.en: He was concerned that he would be outed as a snitch to the Buck Wild gang, but he eventually succumbed to the pressure to cooperate.
sentences.zh: 他担心自己作为告密者的身份会被泄露给“Buck Wild”帮派，但他最终屈服于压力，选择了合作。

sentences.en: The detectives wanted Mohamed to wear a wire to his meeting with Dahlia on August 1, but he said it would be risky as she would likely perform oral sex on him.
sentences.zh: 警探们希望穆罕默德在8月1日与达莉亚见面时佩戴窃听器，但他表示这很冒险，因为她很可能会对他进行口交。

sentences.en: Instead, detectives fitted
sentences.zh: 相反，警探们在

sentences.en: Mohamed's vehicle with a pinhole video camera and a covert listening device, which allowed them to hear the conversation in real time.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德的车里安装了一个针孔摄像机和一个隐蔽的监听设备，这让他们能够实时听到谈话内容。

sentences.en: They recorded Dahlia as she agreed to Mohamed's offer to hire a former military hitman and handed over the photographs and initial payment.
sentences.zh: 他们录下了达莉亚同意穆罕默德雇佣一名前军事杀手的提议，并交出照片和首付款的过程。

sentences.en: This meeting also provided police with the opportunity to run Dahlia's licence plates through their system in order to confirm her husband's identity.
sentences.zh: 这次会面也为警方提供了机会，通过他们的系统查询达莉亚的车牌，以确认她丈夫的身份。

sentences.en: On Monday August 3, an undercover officer from Boynton Beach Police Department's community action team called Dahlia to pose as the hitman.
sentences.zh: 8月3日星期一，博因顿海滩警察局社区行动小组的一名卧底警官打电话给达莉亚，冒充杀手。

sentences.en: Officer Witty Jean was selected for the role because he was a black man with cornrows in his hair, which likely matched the image Dahlia had of a hitman
sentences.zh: 维蒂·吉恩警官被选中担任这个角色，因为他是一名留着玉米垄发型的黑人，这很可能符合达莉亚心目中杀手的形象，

sentences.en: based on her previous encounters with the Buck Wild gang.
sentences.zh: 基于她之前与“Buck Wild”帮派的接触。

sentences.en: Officer Jean told Dahlia he was driving up from
sentences.zh: 吉恩警官告诉达莉亚他正从

sentences.en: Miami and would call again to arrange a place to meet once he was closer.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密开车过来，等他靠近后会再次打电话安排见面地点。

sentences.en: He also requested an upfront payment of $3,000 as well as a key to Dahlia's house.
sentences.zh: 他还要求预付3000美元，以及达莉亚家的钥匙。

sentences.en: After the call ended, Dahlia phoned Mohamed to complain about the increased fee and said she was worried the hitman would rob her house.
sentences.zh: 通话结束后，达莉亚打电话给穆罕默德抱怨费用增加，并说她担心杀手会抢劫她的房子。

sentences.en: Shortly after
sentences.zh: 下午4点

sentences.en: 4pm, Officer Jean called Dahlia and asked her to meet him in the parking lot of a CVS pharmacy on North
sentences.zh: 刚过，吉恩警官打电话给达莉亚，约她在北部的CVS药店停车场见面

sentences.en: Military Trail in West Palm Beach.
sentences.zh: 西棕榈滩的军事小径。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to her, his red Chrysler convertible was fitted with audio and video recording devices and being surveilled by a team of officers.
sentences.zh: 她不知道的是，他的红色克莱斯勒敞篷车上安装了音频和视频记录设备，并受到一组警官的监视。

sentences.en: Mohamed and Dahlia drove to the meeting spot and Dahlia got into Officer Jean's convertible while Mohamed waited outside the car.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德和达莉亚开车到了见面地点，达莉亚上了吉恩警官的敞篷车，而穆罕默德在车外等候。

sentences.en: Officer Jean asked Dahlia for the money, her house key and alarm codes.
sentences.zh: 吉恩警官向达莉亚索要钱、房门钥匙和警报密码。

sentences.en: She told him she didn't bring any cash with her and would have to pay after the hit was done.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他她没带现金，必须在任务完成后才能付款。

sentences.en: Officer Jean agreed but increased the price to $7,000.
sentences.zh: 吉恩警官同意了，但将价格提高到了7000美元。

sentences.en: Dahlia assured him she was good for the money because, quote, that's the kind of person I am.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚向他保证她付得起钱，因为，引用她的话，“我就是那种人”。

sentences.en: On the morning of Wednesday August 5, Michael was planning to withdraw $10,000 cash to pay his business partner.
sentences.zh: 8月5日星期三上午，迈克尔计划取出1万美元现金支付给他的商业合伙人。

sentences.en: Dahlia and Officer Jean agreed that the hit should be carried out then and made to look like a botched robbery, with Dahlia suggesting that Officer Jean keep
sentences.zh: 达莉亚和吉恩警官同意在那时执行任务，并将其伪装成一起失败的抢劫案，达莉亚建议吉恩警官保留

sentences.en: the money as his payment.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱作为他的报酬。

sentences.en: She provided the address along with specific directions to the Dippolito's townhouse and stated,
sentences.zh: 她提供了地址以及前往迪波利托联排别墅的具体路线，并说道：

sentences.en: I'm a lot tougher than what I look.
sentences.zh: “我比看起来要强硬得多。”

sentences.en: I know what you're thinking.
sentences.zh: “我知道你在想什么。”

sentences.en: You're like, oh, what a cute little girl.
sentences.zh: “你肯定在想，哦，多可爱的小姑娘。”

sentences.en: Whatever, you know.
sentences.zh: “随便你怎么想。”

sentences.en: But I'm not.
sentences.zh: “但我不是。”

sentences.en: Officer Jean told Dahlia that after their meeting ended, she wouldn't be able to change her mind.
sentences.zh: 吉恩警官告诉达莉亚，在他们的会面结束后，她就不能改变主意了。

sentences.en: He asked if she definitely wanted to proceed, to which Dahlia responded, I'm positive, like 5,000% sure.
sentences.zh: 他问她是否确定要继续，达莉亚回答说：“我很肯定，百分之五千确定。”

sentences.en: When I say I'm gonna do something, I'm gonna do it.
sentences.zh: “我说到做到。”

sentences.en: The following day, officers from Boynton Beach Police Department held a meeting to discuss their plans for the staged crime scene.
sentences.zh: 第二天，博因顿海滩警察局的警官们召开会议，讨论他们对伪造犯罪现场的计划。

sentences.en: Coincidentally, a camera crew from the Fox network reality television show Cops was scheduled to start shooting with the department that week as part of a pre-arranged
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，福克斯电视网真人秀节目《警察》的摄制组原定于那周开始与该部门合作拍摄，作为预先安排的

sentences.en: public relations agreement.
sentences.zh: 公共关系协议的一部分。

sentences.en: On a whim, Sergeant Paul Sheridan suggested the Cops team filmed the staged scene.
sentences.zh: 保罗·谢里丹警官突发奇想，建议《警察》摄制组拍摄这个伪造的现场。

sentences.en: All relevant parties agreed that Dahlia had already committed the crime of solicitation to commit
sentences.zh: 所有相关方都同意，达莉亚在与穆罕默德交换金钱时，已经犯下了教唆犯下

sentences.en: first-degree murder when she exchanged money with Muhammad and therefore filming wouldn't be in breach of the active investigation.
sentences.zh: 一级谋杀罪，因此拍摄不会妨碍正在进行的调查。

sentences.en: It was decided that when Dahlia arrived at the pseudo-crime scene, the cops crew would be cordoned off behind police tape to look like regular members of the press.
sentences.zh: 决定当达莉亚到达伪犯罪现场时，摄制组将被隔离在警戒线后，看起来就像普通的媒体成员。

sentences.en: On Tuesday August 4, Officer Jean called Dahlia to confirm the hit would take place the following day.
sentences.zh: 8月4日星期二，吉恩警官打电话给达莉亚，确认任务将在第二天执行。

sentences.en: He explained that waiting until Michael had withdrawn his money from the bank wasn't viable and instead instructed Dahlia to vacate the townhouse by 6am.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，等到迈克尔从银行取钱后再行动不可行，并指示达莉亚在早上6点前离开联排别墅。

sentences.en: At 5.58 the following morning, after Dahlia left for the gym, the police arrived at the Dippolito's townhouse where Sergeant Sheridan informed Michael,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上5点58分，达莉亚去健身房后，警察来到迪波利托的联排别墅，谢里丹警官通知迈克尔：

sentences.en: I need to tell you something real quick here.
sentences.zh: “我需要马上告诉你一件事。”

sentences.en: You need to come with me to the police station.
sentences.zh: “你需要跟我去一趟警察局。”

sentences.en: You're not in trouble.
sentences.zh: “你没有惹麻烦。”

sentences.en: Your wife has hired someone to kill you.
sentences.zh: “你妻子雇了人来杀你。”

sentences.en: A visibly shocked Michael was immediately taken to the Boynton Beach police station where he told interviewing detectives about the strange
sentences.zh: 迈克尔显然受到了惊吓，他被立即带到了博因顿海滩警察局，在那里他向负责审讯的警探讲述了那些奇怪的

sentences.en: things that had started happening a month after he and Dahlia married.
sentences.zh: 事情，这些事在他和达莉亚结婚一个月后就开始发生了。

sentences.en: He mentioned the random drug raids, revealing that the day after his car was searched at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, he found a bag
sentences.zh: 他提到了那些随机的毒品搜查，并透露在他那辆车在丽思卡尔顿酒店被搜查的第二天，他发现了一个袋子，

sentences.en: of cocaine and Xanax stuffed into the cap of his gas tank.
sentences.zh: 里面装满了可卡因和赞安诺，被塞进了他的油箱盖里。

sentences.en: The police had missed them during their search, and terrified of being found in violation of his parole, Michael had thrown the drugs away.
sentences.zh: 警方在搜查时漏掉了这些东西，迈克尔因为害怕被发现违反假释规定，就把毒品扔掉了。

sentences.en: Dahlia had seemed shocked when he told her, but Michael suspected she was the one who planted them
sentences.zh: 当迈克尔告诉达莉亚时，她看起来很震惊，但迈克尔怀疑是她把这些东西

sentences.zh: 放在那里的，还有在城市广场购物中心搜查时在他备胎下发现的可卡因也是。

sentences.zh: 他还怀疑是她导致了自己在偿还赔偿金方面遇到了困难。

sentences.en: Michael confronted Dahlia and threatened to leave.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔与达莉亚对质，并威胁要离开她。

sentences.en: Dahlia was upset and acknowledged she had made a mistake by trying to wire the original restitution payment through the Cayman Islands.
sentences.zh: 达莉亚很心烦，承认自己犯了个错误，试图通过开曼群岛汇出最初的赔偿金。

sentences.en: She insisted there was nothing to be suspicious of and that Eric Tao was trying to help her fix the error.
sentences.zh: 她坚称没什么可疑的，并说埃里克·陶当时是在帮她纠正这个错误。

sentences.en: When the detectives asked Michael what motivated Dahlia to order his murder, he said it likely had
sentences.zh: 当警探问迈克尔是什么促使达莉亚策划谋杀他时，他说这很可能与

sentences.en: something to do with the townhouse he had just signed over to her and the money she had stolen.
sentences.zh: 他刚转让给她的联排别墅以及她偷走的钱有关。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: That's why today, honestly, I'm not that surprised or shocked about all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，老实说，我对这一切并不感到惊讶或震惊。

sentences.en: I mean, fool me once, fool me twice, fool me three times.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，骗我一次，骗我两次，骗我三次。

sentences.en: At this point, there's just nothing left to say.
